results.content: # 'NAZA,' an Israeli Documentary About Israel's Actions in Gaza, to Premiere at Venice Film Festival. Directed by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, 'NAZA,' which derives its name from the Hebrew military acronym for collateral damage, is billed as showing 'in detail the systems behind Israel's calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza'.
